items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Dick, I'll tell you why... Dick, I didn't come to New Orleans until I left the Army... Dick, what I want to ask you

ctx.x: Yeah, I thought maybe they took some of those songs that they sang while they were working and

made them into jazz tunes. Well no, they didn't in them times. Dick, I'll tell you why, there wasn't nobody there to fix nothing like that, you know. Now he did, I'd pick up on something like that and
make something out of it, you know. Well what about in the churches? What went on now?
